Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_COMERCIO_INTERNACIONAL: East India and Levant companies with royal charters carry our flag to distant markets. Establish such Chartered Companies and we will be able to build a \cFFFF61Trade Branch\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Agrarian Revolution Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_SIDERURGIA: Henry Cort's puddling furnace and grooved rolls (1784) turn coal-smelted pig iron into bar iron in great quantity. Puddling and Rolling will allow us to build \cFFFF61Steel Mills\c, thus increasing our output of Raw Materials.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CATASTRO: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Absolute Monarchies\c, a Cadastral Survey, like the Theresian and Josephine cadastres, measures every field so that every subject pays his taxes. It increases production of Gold by \cFFFF6110%\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_PRESION_FISCAL: The Republic replaced the tax farmers with one national administration of direct taxes. Fiscal Centralisation increases the amount of tax collected by our officials and lets us build the \cFFFF61Treasury Department\c. This is exclusive to \cFFFF61Republics\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_MANIOBRAS_NAVALES: At the Nile and Trafalgar Nelson broke through the enemy line instead of fighting it ship for ship. Learning to Break the Line will allow us to build the \cFFFF61Naval Academy\c and increase Crew experience.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_VACUNACION: Inoculation with smallpox matter, long practised in China and the Ottoman Empire, protects our people from the deadliest disease of the age. Research Smallpox Inoculation to build \cFFFF61Local Hospitals\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Medical Revolution Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CUERPO_VOLUNTARIOS: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Absolute Monarchies\c, the Landwehr militia raised in Austria (1808) and Prussia (1813) swells the ranks of our armies, as military units will become \cFFFF6110%\c cheaper to recruit and train.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_POLICIA_SECRETA: Napoleon's Ministry of Police watches émigrés, royalists and Jacobins alike. It is a powerful tool for obtaining information and for suppressing any opposition. Develop it to build \cFFFF61Police Stations\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CONSERVACION_ALIMENTOS: Since the wars of Louis XIV, armies have marched on chains of supply depots. Organise a Magazine System of salted provisions, biscuit and grain and we will be able to build \cFFFF61Rations Warehouses\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_ALTO_MANDO: Scharnhorst and Gneisenau rebuilt the Prussian army after Jena: promotion by merit, a trained staff, a nation in arms. The Scharnhorst Reforms let us build the \cFFFF61Elite Military Academy\c. They also increase the damage caused by your infantry's melée and cavalry's \cFFFF61Charge\c attacks.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_PREFECTURA: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Dictatorships\c, the Prefects created by Napoleon in 1800 govern each department for Paris, centralising the administration of agricultural output and increasing the production of Food across the Empire by \cFFFF6150%\c from its initial rate.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_ILUSTRACION: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Absolute Monarchies\c, Enlightened Absolutism - the way of Frederick II, Joseph II and Catherine II - puts reason and science at the service of the crown. It will increase production of Research Points by \cFFFF6110%\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the 100.000 Sons of St. Louis Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_MANIOBRAS_MILITARES: Guibert's Essai general de tactique (1772) split armies into divisions that march apart and fight together. Adopting the Divisional System will increase infantry and cavalry \cFFFF61resistance\c to Melée attacks, and \cFFFF61damage\c caused by their Ranged attacks. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the World Fair Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_ASISTENCIA_SANITARIA: Edward Jenner's cowpox vaccine of 1796 is safer than inoculation, and Napoleon had his whole army vaccinated in 1805. Cowpox Vaccination will increase life expectancy and thus our population. Develop it in order to build \cFFFF61Modern Hospitals\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_PERIODISMO: In 1789 hundreds of newspapers and pamphlets appeared in Paris alone. A Revolutionary Press promotes our image in foreign countries: it activates the \cFFFF61Improve Relations\c diplomacy option, and lets us build the \cFFFF61Newspaper Office\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Rosetta Stone Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CARRERA_MILITAR: Royal military schools such as the Ecole Militaire (1750) and the Theresian Academy (1751) turn noble sons into professional officers. Once this programme is in place, we may build the \cFFFF61Military Academy\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_REVOLUCION_INDUSTRIAL: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Constitutional Monarchies\c, the Factory System of Arkwright's mills gathers workers and machines under one roof. Thus, the production of Raw Materials will increase by \cFFFF6110%\c from its initial rate.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CIRUGIA: Dominique-Jean Larrey's flying ambulances of 1792 carry the wounded from the field while the battle still rages. Develop them to build \cFFFF61Military Hospitals\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_ANEXION_PACIFICA: Let others wage war; marriages, inheritances and treaties have built the greatest houses of Europe. Master Dynastic Diplomacy and we may build the \cFFFF61Consulate\c. This will also activate the \cFFFF61Commercial Treaty\c diplomacy option.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_REFORMA_AGRARIA: The Prussian October Edict of 1807 freed the peasants and opened the land market. Emancipation Edicts raise agricultural productivity and allow us to construct the \cFFFF61Ministry of Agriculture\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_SUBVERSION: The Spanish guerrilla from 1808 showed how a people in arms can bleed an occupying army. Promote such uprisings in regions controlled by a rival Empire: research Guerrilla Warfare to build the \cFFFF61Resistance Cell\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_SINDICALISMO: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Republics\c, the Sans-culotte Sections of Paris gave artisans and workers a voice in the Revolution. They will improve Population production by \cFFFF6125%\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_PIRATERIA: Letters of marque turn merchant captains into privateers - Surcouf alone took dozens of British ships. By encouraging Privateering we will be able to build facilities which will allow us to continue trading, even when our harbours suffer blockades.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_PROPAGANDA: The Bulletins of the Grande Armée told Europe of every victory - and of few defeats. Imperial Bulletins, distributed across lands intended to be annexed, strengthen our influence on their populace and let us create the \cFFFF61Army Bulletin\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_DIEZMO: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Absolute Monarchies\c, the Tithe is a special tax which will allow us to increase Food production by \cFFFF6150%\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_AGRICULTURA_MODERNA: Bakewell's selective breeding, Norfolk crop rotation and the new agricultural societies raise yields everywhere. With Improved Husbandry our Empire will be able to build \cFFFF61Subsidised Farms\c and thus improve production of Food.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_ARMADA_MODERNA: Sané's standard 74-gun design let French yards build identical ships of the line in series. Standard Ship Designs will allow our Empire to build a \cFFFF61Military Dockyard\c, complete with the latest equipment and facilities needed to build the finest vessels.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_BOMBA_VAPOR: James Watt's engine with separate condenser (1776) pumps water from mines far below the old workings, and allows us to construct \cFFFF61Deep-shaft Mines\c, which will increase our production of Raw Materials.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CABALLERIA_AVANZADA: Armoured cuirassiers held in reserve deliver the decisive charge, as at Eylau in 1807. Forming a Cuirassier Reserve will allow us to construct \cFFFF61Advanced Stables\c, which may be built in all capital cities which have \cFFFF61Basic Stables\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Simon Bolivar Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CABALLERIA_BASICA: Hussars, chasseurs and Cossacks screen the army, scout and pursue a broken enemy. Research Hussars and Light Horse in order to build the \cFFFF61Basic Stables\c and start recruiting such units. This will also activate the possibility of \cFFFF61capturing prisoners\c in battle.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CABALLERIA_ELITE: The Polish lancers of the Guard (1807) made the lance feared again, and every army copied them. Raising Lancer Regiments will enable us to build the \cFFFF61Elite Stables\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CAPITALISMO: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Constitutional Monarchies\c, a Funded National Debt, backed by Parliament and the Bank of England, lets the state borrow cheaply in any war, giving the Treasury an additional \cFFFF6120%\c over our initial Gold production without the need for any accompanying construction.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CONSTRUCCION_ARTILLERIA: Gribeauval's system of 1765 gave France light, standardised guns with interchangeable parts. Adopting it and constructing \cFFFF61Basic Foundries\c will allow us to build Cannons for our army. This also activates the ability to \cFFFF61capture artillery\c during battles.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_EDUCACION_AVANZADA: Wilhelm von Humboldt's University of Berlin (1810) unites teaching with research. By founding a Humboldtian University, we will be able to build \cFFFF61Universities\c, and so improve our production of Research Points.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_EDUCACION_BASICA: Prussia's school law of 1763 showed that every parish can teach its children to read. Research Elementary Schooling and we will be able to build \cFFFF61Primary Schools\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Railway Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_EDUCACION_MODERNA: The Ecole Polytechnique (1794) trains engineers and artillerists in mathematics and science. Found Polytechnic Schools to build \cFFFF61Specialised Schools\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Metric System Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_GUARDACOSTAS: Aimé Argand's oil lamp of 1780, set before polished reflectors, makes lights visible far out to sea. A Coastal Lights Service, when coupled with the latest \cFFFF61Argand Lighthouse\c technology, can be a useful tool for improving our knowledge of the surrounding seas. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Cartography Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_IMPUESTO_RENTAS: In 1799 William Pitt introduced the first income tax to pay for the war against France. Establishing such a tax allows Democratic governments to build \cFFFF61Tax Collection Buildings\c, and so improve their production of Gold.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_INFANTERIA_AVANZADA: French tirailleurs and the British 95th Rifles fight in open order, yet must still form square against horsemen. Drill your troops so that they may learn the \cFFFF61Square formation\c - invaluable against cavalry charges. With training concluded, \cFFFF61Advanced Barracks\c may then be built in all capital cities with a \cFFFF61Basic Barracks\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_INFANTERIA_BASICA: Drilled to the regulations of the 1790s, line infantry delivers volley fire shoulder to shoulder. Research Line Infantry Drill and we will be able to build \cFFFF61Basic Barracks\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_INFANTERIA_ELITE: The Imperial Guard, veterans of a dozen campaigns, is committed only when the battle must be won. Raising such a Guard will enable us to build the \cFFFF61Elite Barracks\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_INFRAESTRUCTURA_NAVAL: Since the 1780s the Royal Navy sheathes its hulls in copper, keeping them fast and free of shipworm. Copper Sheathing will allow construction of a \cFFFF61Military Harbour\c at our wharves. This also activates the ability to \cFFFF61capture ships\c after battles. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Ruler of the Seas Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_INFRAESTRUCTURA_PORTUARIA: Breakwaters, quays and dredged channels, like those built at Cherbourg from 1783, are vital if we wish to create commercial sea routes, as they allow construction of \cFFFF61Merchant Harbours\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_INGENIERIA_FISCAL: The Banque de France (1800) and a sound public credit pay for armies without ruinous loans. Developing Public Credit is exclusive to \cFFFF61Republics\c. It will enable us to build the \cFFFF61Central Bank\c and thus, improve our economy.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_INSTRUCCION_OFICIALES: Berthier's staff and the Prussian General Staff of 1803 turn a general's will into orders for a hundred thousand men. A General Staff grants our cavalry increased damage to its \cFFFF61Charge\c attacks, enables us to build the \cFFFF61Advanced Military Academy\c, and enables our infantry to use the \cFFFF61Double Line formation\c. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Treaty of Amiens Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_MANUFACTURA_ARTILLERIA: Horse artillery, with every gunner mounted, keeps pace with the cavalry and gallops into firing range. Researching it will allow our Empire to build \cFFFF61Advanced Foundries\c and so equip our Army with larger and more effective Cannons.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_MERCADO_DOMESTICO: Adam Smith's Wealth of Nations (1776) and Turgot's reforms argue for the free movement of grain and goods. The Free Trade Doctrine will allow our Empire to construct the \cFFFF61Department of Trade\c and also activate the \cFFFF61Right of Passage\c diplomacy option.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_MODERNIZACION_PUERTOS: Enclosed dockyards with new quays, loading docks and bonded warehouses, as at Liverpool and Antwerp, are vital for commercial sea routes. Research them to build \cFFFF61Merchant Dockyards\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_ORGANIZACION_NAVAL: Home Popham's signal code of 1800 lets an admiral speak to his whole fleet with flags. This Advance makes it possible for our Empire to build the \cFFFF61Military Port\c - an important milestone in the formation of a strong Navy.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_PROD_IND_ARTILLERIA: At Wagram in 1809 a battery of more than a hundred guns smashed the Austrian centre. The Grand Battery represents the final step in the development of our Artillery industry, allowing us to build \cFFFF61Elite Foundries\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_PUERTOS_INDUSTRIALIZADOS: London's West India Docks (1802) lock ships into guarded basins, safe from tides and thieves. Building Wet Docks and constructing \cFFFF61Merchant Ports\c is an important step in increasing the profitability of commercial sea routes.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_RECLUTAMIENTO_FORZOSO: Exclusive to \cFFFF61Dictatorships\c, the Jourdan Law of 1798 makes every young man liable to serve. It will grant our Empire a period of \cFFFF616\c turns during which we may recruit basic infantry \cFFFF6150%\c cheaper. This opportunity will then reoccur every \cFFFF6120\c turns.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_RECONOCIMIENTO_NAVAL: Robert Stevenson's Bell Rock Lighthouse (1810) stands on a reef covered by every tide. Rock Lighthouses represent the final step in the development of our Harbours. With them, we may construct the \cFFFF61Fresnel Lighthouse\c and increase our knowledge of surrounding waters.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_RED_ESPIONAJE: Joseph Fouché's agents and informers reach into every salon and every foreign court. Fouché's Spy Network allows us to build the \cFFFF61Ministry of Foreign Affairs\c. It also grants the \cFFFF61Industrial Espionage\c feature, which informs us of what other countries are building. \n \n\cE61414Also activates the Continental Blockade Quest.\c
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_SERVICIO_MILITAR: After 1807 Prussia, limited to 42,000 soldiers, trained men in short turns and sent them home as a hidden reserve. The Krümper System is an extremely useful tool for increasing our Empire's population, when used in conjunction with \cFFFF61Enlistment Offices\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_SERVICIO_SECRETO: The Cabinet Noir secretly opens and copies the letters of ambassadors and conspirators. Developing it and constructing the \cFFFF61Department of Information\c will provide our Empire with valuable information on surrounding countries.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_SIERRA_CIRCULAR: Samuel Miller's circular saw of 1777, driven by water wheels, cuts timber far faster than the pit saw. Development of this Advance will enable us to build \cFFFF61Saw Mills\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CAMBIO_ERA1: In 1792 revolutionary France went to war with the crowned heads of Europe. As we advance to the next Era of our Times, you will be able to choose for our Empire, one of two political systems - \cFFFF61Autocratic\c or \cFFFF61Democratic\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_CAMBIO_ERA2: With the Berlin Decree of 1806 Napoleon closed the continent to British trade, and every state had to take a side. As we advance to the final Era of our Times, you will be able to choose one of the following political ideals - \cFFFF61Dictatorship\c, \cFFFF61Absolute Monarchy\c, \cFFFF61Republic\c or \cFFFF61Constitutional Monarchy\c.
Management\\TextDescripcionesTecnologias.LTEXT_DESC_MANIOBRAS_NACIONALES: From 1800 Napoleon's armies march as self-contained corps of all arms that can fight alone for a day. The Corps d'Armée System increases our Artillery's effective \cFFFF61Impact area\c and its resistance to Ranged attacks. This Advance also allows us to build \cFFFF61Firing Ranges\c.

Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_PERSIA: Persia rises again under the new Qajar dynasty. Rich in men but poor in coin, it stands between the Ottoman Empire and the steppe peoples. Its cavalry is excellent and its mountains are hard to conquer.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_ARABIA: The emirs of Diriyah are uniting the tribes of the Arabian peninsula. The desert protects them, but it gives little. Camel riders and fast cavalry are their strength; Oman gives them a window on the sea.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_TURKESTAN: The Emirate of Bukhara rules the old Silk Road cities east of the Caspian Sea. Trade brings wealth, but Russia and Persia watch its borders closely.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_CHECHNYA: Sheikh Mansur has raised the mountain peoples of the North Caucasus against the Russian advance. The forests and gorges of Chechenya and Dagestan are a fortress; the Ottomans are distant friends, Russia a near enemy.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_QING: The Qianlong Emperor rules the largest and richest empire on earth from Beijing. Its armies are vast but old-fashioned, and only Canton is open to European trade.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_JAPAN: The Tokugawa shogun keeps Japan closed to the world. Only the Dutch may trade, at Nagasaki. Its samurai have not fought a war in nearly two hundred years.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_MARATHA: The Peshwa at Pune leads the great Maratha chiefs, the strongest native power in India. They hold Delhi and the Mughal emperor, but the British watch from Bengal and Bombay.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_ETHIOPIA: The ancient Christian empire of Ethiopia is ruled in name by the emperor at Gondar and in fact by its warlords.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_INDEPENDENT: Kingdoms, sultanates, chiefdoms and free peoples that answer to no great power. They defend their land, but they do not seek conquest.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_PRINCES: Kingdoms, sultanates, chiefdoms and free peoples that answer to no great power. They defend their land, but they do not seek conquest.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_SHEIKHS: Kingdoms, sultanates, chiefdoms and free peoples that answer to no great power. They defend their land, but they do not seek conquest.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_NILE: Kingdoms, sultanates, chiefdoms and free peoples that answer to no great power. They defend their land, but they do not seek conquest.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_PACIFIC: Kingdoms, sultanates, chiefdoms and free peoples that answer to no great power. They defend their land, but they do not seek conquest.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_MOLDAVIA: The kingdoms of the Kongo, the Lunda, the Rozvi and Madagascar.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_SAJONIA: The oases of the Sahara and the kingdoms of the Niger and Volta.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_HANNOVER: The Kazakh hordes roam the great steppe between Russia and Turkestan. Their horsemen are feared, but the khanate has few towns and little industry.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_ESPANYA: Spain still rules a vast empire overseas, but at home it is a tired power between France and the sea. Its fleet and its American silver are its strength.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_ESPANYA_QUICKG: Spain still rules a vast empire overseas, but at home it is a tired power between France and the sea. Its fleet and its American silver are its strength.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_OTOMANO: The Sultan in Constantinople rules from the Balkans to Arabia. The empire is huge but slow, and Russia and Austria press on its borders.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_OTOMANO_QUICKG: The Sultan in Constantinople rules from the Balkans to Arabia. The empire is huge but slow, and Russia and Austria press on its borders.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_EGIPTO: Egypt, rich from the Nile and the trade between two seas, is nominally Ottoman but goes its own way.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_EGIPTO_QUICKGA: Egypt, rich from the Nile and the trade between two seas, is nominally Ottoman but goes its own way.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_DOS_SICILIAS: The Kingdom of the Two Sicilies holds southern Italy and Sicily, a Mediterranean crossroads with a modest fleet.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_DOS_SICILIAS_Q: The Kingdom of the Two Sicilies holds southern Italy and Sicily, a Mediterranean crossroads with a modest fleet.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_DINAMARCA: Denmark and Norway guard the gates of the Baltic. A small kingdom with a proud navy.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_DINAMARCA_QUIC: Denmark and Norway guard the gates of the Baltic. A small kingdom with a proud navy.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_SUECIA: Sweden, once the master of the Baltic, rules Sweden and Finland and dreams of its old glory.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_SUECIA_QUICKGA: Sweden, once the master of the Baltic, rules Sweden and Finland and dreams of its old glory.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_PORTUGAL: Portugal looks to the ocean and its colonies, an old ally of Britain at the edge of Europe.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_PORTUGAL_QUICK: Portugal looks to the ocean and its colonies, an old ally of Britain at the edge of Europe.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_LOMBARDIA: Lombardy and Venice, the rich plains and trading cities of northern Italy.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_LOMBARDIA_QUIC: Lombardy and Venice, the rich plains and trading cities of northern Italy.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_PIAMONTE: Piedmont-Sardinia, a small but ambitious kingdom at the foot of the Alps.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_PIAMONTE_QUICK: Piedmont-Sardinia, a small but ambitious kingdom at the foot of the Alps.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_EPAPALES: The Papal States rule central Italy from Rome, with more influence than armies.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_EPAPALES_QUICK: The Papal States rule central Italy from Rome, with more influence than armies.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_RHELVETICA: The Swiss cantons, a mountain fortress in the heart of Europe.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_RHELVETICA_QUI: The Swiss cantons, a mountain fortress in the heart of Europe.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_BATAVIA: The Netherlands, a nation of merchants and sailors with a worldwide trade.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_BATAVIA_QUICKG: The Netherlands, a nation of merchants and sailors with a worldwide trade.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_POLONIA: Poland, a great old commonwealth squeezed between Prussia, Austria and Russia.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_POLONIA_QUICKG: Poland, a great old commonwealth squeezed between Prussia, Austria and Russia.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_MARRUECOS: The Sultanate of Morocco, between the Atlantic, the Atlas mountains and the Sahara.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_MARRUECOS_QUIC: The Sultanate of Morocco, between the Atlantic, the Atlas mountains and the Sahara.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_TUNEZ: Tunis, a Barbary state of corsairs and caravan trade on the African shore.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_TUNEZ_QUICKGAM: Tunis, a Barbary state of corsairs and caravan trade on the African shore.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_TRIPOLITANIA: Tripoli, a Barbary regency whose corsairs raid the Mediterranean.
Others\\TextUIMainMenu.sb.LTEXT_UI_MAINMENU_SI_INFO_TRIPOLITANIA_Q: Tripoli, a Barbary regency whose corsairs raid the Mediterranean.
